title: Slipperslappers
html_source:
Old Mother Slipperslapper is a type of the “poor old woman” who personifies Ireland. She appears in the folk song “The Fox” to announce, “John, John, the grey goose is gone / And the fox is on the town, O”.

First verse: “Old Mother Slipper Slapper jumpt out of bed, / And out at the casement she popt her head, / Crying the house is on fire, the grey goose is dead, / And the fox is come to the town, O”.

In the case in point Old Mother Slipperslapper is representative of Ireland, all womankind, and women who prepare the bodies for burial in Ireland.
